title: Prevent one pending causal admission target from starving later targets
outcome: Within the bounded recovery pass, a target-specific pending outcome does not indefinitely prevent the other captured targets of the same completion from being attempted.
acceptance: A behavioral test holds one target pending while another remains admissible, and observes progress on the latter without changing either original operation key, body, connection or receipt.
Per-pass work remains bounded and uncertain-write custody is retained.
